description: Search EU regulations and directives, and Court of Justice / European Court of Human Rights judgments, by Estonian title or case number. The corpus is Estonian-language throughout: 94% of the Court of Justice's output is translated into Estonian, and essentially nothing indexes it in Estonian. Returns ids usable with eu_law_fetch.

query.description: Estonian title words, or a case number such as 'C-362/14'.

name: eu_law_search
title: Search EU law in Estonian
